extraction: Exact original 48-byte VAG header plus unmodified ADPCM payload

entries.embedded_english: Quite  a view, ain't it?
Don't move!
No one's getting to the summit unless we silence those guns.
Rest up here for a moment.
Know how many caves they got up on that mountain?  Those guns could be hidden anywhere up there.
I'll tell you boys, the Japanese want this mountain so bad, they can have it. It’s just a whole mess of jungle and… (slap) ‘sonova’… bugs.
Hell…. the whole Japanese army could have been hiding in here, and we'd never have known it.  Place is invisible!
Damn it, Polonsky.   Keep that big mouth of yours shut for once.
He's hit. Get out of there!
Watch it - spider hole!
Get back. Move! Move!
Snipers! Up on the rock face!
Snipers! At the end of the gully.
We've got to knock out those MGs. Miller, head left and flank their position. We'll cover you.
MG! Take cover!
Get some fire in there!
<Surrender! We Surrender!>
Best seat in the house. We've done our part boys - cleared a path to the summit for the 27th. There'll be no more hiding places up here.
Hey you. Turn around! I said turn around! What you doing you dumb…
Quit your bitching, Polonsky. We've got our orders. The Japanese are dug in all across this damn mountain, and hell, if they didn't go and hide a couple of 88's up there too.
You got point, Miller.
The Sarge wants you out front, Marine.
Didn't stand a chance. Once the fuel tank's hit.…
Keep up the pressure. Roll them up.
Hold fire. They're Marines!
Spread out and watch for ambush points.
Miller, take two men and scout the area ahead.
Watch that gully. They're trying to flank us.
Okay, let's clear out this cave. And take it slow, men.
More of them! In that cave mouth!
Look out! He's still moving!
<Don't shoot! Don't Shoot!>
Hold your fire! They're surrendering!
My favourite kind of Japanese - ones that ain't shooting at me.  (to prisoners) Hands in the air!
Get down!!!
Goddamn it, Polonsky, you lucky sonuva...
I'm okay, Sarge.   That's the last time I let one of these guys bow down, that's for sure.
Covering fire! Move it, Miller!
Hell, those japanese are gonna run out of island real soon.
Artillery guns make noise, Polonsky.  Just follow the noise, and you'll find the guns.  That's why the Marine Corps issued you with a pair of ears, remember?
Who's that over there?  The 27th Infantry?  Jeez, looks like those guys are catching hell over there...
Clear that entrance.  Couple of grenades should finish 'em.
Get in the trench!
Come on, Marines! Let's go up there and give them hell.
Up there. See the guns?
Look at how they're dug into the rock.  No wonder the navy couldn't hit them.
Ammo porters!  Don't let 'em get away.
We’ve got them on the run now.
Hear that?  We're getting close to those guns now.
Nice work, Miller.
Push up.  Don't stop for anything.
Hey, I’ve got something here!
Look at all these maps. We've hit the jackpot.  The boys at Batallion HQ are gonna love us!
You see a jackpot, I see likely booby traps.  Don't touch anything!
Ambush! Take cover
Captain.

The 27th are going nowhere fast. We've got Japanese dug in hard all across the front, and hell, if they haven't managed to hide a couple of 88's up there too. They're pounding the life out of our boys.
I want those guns silenced, sergeant.  Take your men and push on - see if you can work your way around.
Know how many caves they got up on that mountain, captain?  Those guns could be hidden anywhere up there.
Artillery guns make noise, Polonsky.  Just follow the noise, and you'll find the guns.  That's why the Marine Corps issued you with a pair of ears, remember?
Yeah.  Just a pity it gave him that big mouth at the same time.
Get to it, Marines! Let's just go up there and silence those guns!
You heard the Captain!
There's always another island, Polonsky. There's always another…
Go, Clear it out!
We've got to clear this trench.
Storm the entrance. Let's go!
Polonsky, get a satchel charge into that bunker!
Cover me. I ain't delivering newspapers here!
MGs! Take cover!
Miller, check it out. We're right behind you.
Clear those spider holes!
